name: Hibernate/JPA HQL-JPQL injection via concatenation
attack_scenario: Attacker supplies name = ' OR '1'='1 (or a native-query UNION SELECT) to bypass filters or exfiltrate other users' rows / arbitrary tables.
negative_test_hint: submit name = "' OR '1'='1" and assert the query returns zero rows or an error, never other users' rows

exemplar.noncompliant: List<User> u = session.createQuery("FROM User u WHERE u.name = '" + name + "'").list();
exemplar.compliant:
List<User> u = session.createQuery("FROM User u WHERE u.name = :name")
        .setParameter("name", name).list();
exemplar.explanation: Building an HQL/JPQL/native query string by concatenating user input lets an attacker alter the query structure. Named bind parameters (setParameter) make the ORM bind values out-of-band, so input can never change the statement.
